mapper.sql: id, platform_id, parent_id, code, name, type, sort, is_system, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_permissions (platform_id, parent_id, code, name, type, sort, is_system) VALUES (#{platformId}, #{parentId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{type}, #{sort}, #{isSystem})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_permissions SET name = #{name}, sort = #{sort}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_permissions WHERE platform_id = #{platformId} AND code = #{code}
SELECT FROM t_permissions WHERE platform_id = #{platformId} ORDER BY sort, id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_permissions WHERE parent_id = #{id}
SELECT permission_id FROM t_role_permissions WHERE role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY permission_id

SELECT DISTINCT pm.code FROM t_permissions pm JOIN t_platforms p ON p.id = pm.platform_id AND p.code = #{platformCode} AND p.is_deleted = 0 JOIN t_role_permissions rp ON rp.permission_id = pm.id JOIN t_roles r ON r.id = rp.role_id AND r.platform_id = pm.platform_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 JOIN t_user_roles ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT pm.code FROM t_permissions pm JOIN t_platforms p ON p.id = pm.platform_id AND p.code = #{platformCode} AND p.is_deleted = 0
